title: 亚马逊买体育不为赚钱：只为让你离不开Prime，高管亲口说透会员逻辑
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Thanks for being here. Yeah, thanks. Um, I wanted to start with the simplest big picture question possible.
segments.zh: 感谢你来。谢谢。我想从最简单的大局问题开始。

segments.en: I think a lot of people that I talk to still struggle to understand what companies like Amazon and Apple are due, like, what is the strategy in media entertainment?
segments.zh: 我交谈过的很多人仍然难以理解像亚马逊和苹果这样的公司，在媒体娱乐领域的战略是什么？

segments.en: But since this is specific to sports, how does streaming, the NFL, the NBA, NASCAR, soccer benefit?
segments.zh: 但既然这是体育专题，流媒体、NFL、NBA、NASCAR、足球如何受益？

segments.en: What is at its core, a retail and cloud company?
segments.zh: 其核心是一家零售和云公司？

segments.en: Yeah, thanks for that. Um, well, first of all, for us, everything comes back to prime. So we sit around and say, how can we make prime better? How can we make it more valuable for prime members?
segments.zh: 是的，谢谢。首先，对我们来说，一切都要回归Prime。我们坐下来思考，如何让Prime更好？如何让它对Prime会员更有价值？

segments.en: We want that to be the best membership program in the world. What does that mean? It means we want our prime members to get so much more value, use prime so much that they're getting so much more value than what we ask them to pay.
segments.zh: 我们希望它成为世界上最好的会员计划。这意味着什么？我们希望Prime会员获得如此多的价值，使用Prime如此频繁，以至于他们获得的价值远远超过我们所要求的付费。

segments.en: Um, now, as you said, it started off as a retail program and free shipping, and which is now one day shipping and even hours.
segments.zh: 现在，正如你所说，它最初是一个零售计划和免费送货，现在是一天送货甚至几小时。

segments.en: But more and more, entertainment's become a really big pillar of that, which makes it a very diverse and differentiated subscription program
segments.zh: 但娱乐越来越成为其中一个非常重要的支柱，这使其成为一个非常多样化和差异化的订阅计划。

segments.en: in prime videos at the center of that. So that's movies, TV shows, with our originals, and of course, sports. In terms of sports, sports role in that,
segments.zh: Prime Video是其中的核心。所以那是电影、电视节目，我们的原创作品，当然还有体育。就体育而言，体育在其中的角色，
